title: Crazy stuff: built this space station animation in about 100 mins!
author: Hot-Chemistry4988

replies.author: Hot-Chemistry4988
replies.body: Gemini 4 Argon in Mixar Application (its an AI native fork of Blender)

replies.author: Gestaltarskiten
replies.body: Genuine question from a noob: why pay for a plan (mixar) instead of using the Blender MCP route?

replies.author: Hot-Chemistry4988
replies.body:
Mixar also has mcp, that you can connect with for free. But it has some additional generation tools. (and if you are using them, then you have to pay)

So its like everything is sitting at one place, i dont have switch application much.

in my case, for this video i have generated an astronaut, for which i had to pay. Remaining thing can be done via MCP route as well.

replies.author: Gestaltarskiten
replies.body: Thanks for answering! And results of the free features are better than Blender MCP? Or Mixar mainly for additional tools behind a plan? 🤔

replies.author: Icy-Perspective-6244
replies.body: What is Mixar? I use ChatGPT Astra and Gemini Antigrav for blender already.

replies.author: Hot-Chemistry4988
replies.body:
i did not try to waste tokens on these. :(  
 majorly focused on the exterior of the space station.

comments.author: titanunveiled
comments.body: I have been doing a lot with opus and blender.  It’s like pulling teeth to get the results I want lol.  Opus creates some compare scripts, try’s to extract a silhouette but it’s never quite right no matter how many iterations.  Maybe I will get Gemini a try

replies.author: Hot-Chemistry4988
replies.body: Opus + Blender is also good, but Mixar was doing better. Dont know man, how
